scope: Pre-release qualification for build 7 installation restoration and shared core ownership; mimo-vm only

candidate.note: Local candidate only. Published build 6 is unchanged; the next published binary needs a new build number.

checks.native_service_tests: passed, including installation state/health/journal, real XPC, per-user state and revision conflicts
checks.installer_daemon_contracts: passed in mimo-vm; late standalone-version guard and setup failure checks rerun and passed

cases: Full Stop then install restores all five jobs, engine/controller/provider and enabled intent in Direct
Individually stopped core/engine/profile restored by install

homebrew.other_account_gui: passed with authenticated current cask: launch GUI as UID 501, full Stop, reinstall from UID 502; other-account GUI closed, services restored
homebrew.cached_older_hook: reproduced refusal to stop UID 501 from UID 502; one-time administrator cleanup succeeded, reinstall migrated the cached hook; next Stop/reinstall with other-account GUI needed no manual cleanup

checks.vm_cleanup: passed: no jobs, app, helpers, Homebrew receipt, Mimo resolver or PF rules; original cask, directory modes and trust restored; no temporary credential request files remain

limits: No new protected-traffic qualification; active Rule/Global mode preservation is covered by state tests.
Physical fast user switching/login-screen freezing not reproduced; multi-account checks use real core clients and existing service authorization/revision tests.
Higher-marketing-version brew upgrade not separately exercised; it uses the same mandatory postflight.
VM Homebrew directory permissions and cask URL were temporary test fixtures.
Initial Debug-bundle/signature and competing-process fixture failures were excluded from passing qualification; final installed regression uses the Release bundle and a compiled C fixture.
Older Homebrew receipts retain their original uninstall hook; closing other-account GUI clients or the documented one-time administrator cleanup may be required for the first migration.
